title: Graduate Legal Technology Analyst
job_type: 21-month graduate scheme (accelerated; Technology Products months 1-9, Practice Group Legal Technology months 10-21)
salary: £30,000 in year one, rising to £33,000 in year two
key_requirements: A degree in any discipline. Excellent problem solving and analytical skills. Genuine interest in technology, innovation and AI. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to build relationships and work collaboratively. Inquisitive mindset and eagerness to learn. Proactive and adaptable approach. Ability to challenge the status quo and contribute ideas.
key_responsibilities: Support the design, development and delivery of legal technology solutions. Work with emerging technologies including AI and automation tools. Analyse legal and business processes to identify improvement opportunities. Gather requirements from stakeholders and translate them into practical technology solutions. Support client-facing technology projects and digital transformation. Assist with data analysis, reporting and insight generation. Collaborate with lawyers, technologists and business teams. Participate in product development, testing and continuous improvement. Present ideas, recommendations and project updates. Contribute to innovation projects.
